Full Body Truck Wrap

Looking to promote your business with a custom-designed vinyl wrap? We are here to make it happen.

Here’s why getting a promotional vinyl wrap is a smart idea:

  • It utilizes the real estate on your vehicle
  • It’s like having a walking billboard
  • There’s no expiry date and you only pay once
  • You are in control of the design
  • and more

If you are a business and want to advertise your vehicle wrap, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is your go-to car wrap shop. Not only that, but we also specialize in signage and equipment wraps. To know the car wrap price, feel free to call us at 416-746-1381 or fill out the form and our experts will get back to you. You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.
